verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents only self-hosted deployment modes: Milvus Lite, Standalone on Docker, and Distributed on Kubernetes. It has no first-party documentation of a fully managed cloud offering or of programmatic provisioning APIs. One community comment refers to a vendor 'Zilliz SaaS', but it does not show a managed Milvus service with programmatic provisioning, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use a fully managed cloud version of the database with programmatic provisioning
